## Free checks (2 minutes, 8 questions, no sign-up)
- [AI Opportunity Check](https://nelsoninno.com/ai-opportunity-check/): how ready a company is to get value from AI (strategy, processes and data, implementation, people and rules). Spanish: [Chequeo de Oportunidades de IA](https://nelsoninno.com/es/chequeo-oportunidades-ia/)
- [Innovation Culture Check](https://nelsoninno.com/innovation-culture-check/): innovation culture based on the Innovator's Triangle (mindset, knowledge, skills, system). Spanish: [Chequeo de Cultura de Innovación](https://nelsoninno.com/es/chequeo-cultura-innovacion/)
- [Learning Program Check](https://nelsoninno.com/learning-program-check/): how well a course, training or curriculum works (goals, design, engagement, measurement). Spanish: [Chequeo de Programa de Aprendizaje](https://nelsoninno.com/es/chequeo-programa-aprendizaje/)
- [AI Visibility Check](https://nelsoninno.com/ai-visibility-check/): how likely ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini are to find and recommend a company (AI answers, website, consistent facts, mentions). Spanish: [Chequeo de Visibilidad en IA](https://nelsoninno.com/es/chequeo-visibilidad-ia/)
- [Team AI Fluency Check](https://nelsoninno.com/team-ai-fluency-check/): how well a team uses AI today (usage, skill, impact, culture). Spanish: [Chequeo de Fluidez en IA del Equipo](https://nelsoninno.com/es/chequeo-fluidez-ia-equipo/)
- Answers stay in the visitor's browser. At the end, visitors can send their result to Nelson Inno and book a free 20-minute diagnosis call.

## Biography
Nelson Inno is a Salvadoran entrepreneur, the co-founder and CEO of WeSpark, and the author of Unstable Innovation. He is a leading reference on innovation, technology, and AI in El Salvador and Central America. He helps enterprises, governments, and universities adopt AI and emerging technology, with education and training as his deepest expertise, and turns strategy into working implementation, automation, and training. He also co-founded everybodyknowsyou, an AI-native web hosting and discoverability venture connecting Central America to AI search engines. He co-designed Bitcoin Diploma 2.0 with El Salvador's National Bitcoin Office, a curriculum the country's Ministry of Education plans to bring to up to 500,000 students over the coming years.

His work has been featured in Forbes Centroamérica, ARD, ZDF, Cointelegraph, and El Salvador's press. His TEDx talk, "Are Schools Prepared for the Future?", explores how learning must change for people to thrive in the world they will actually live in.

Nelson works with US teams remotely. El Salvador is within two hours of every mainland US time zone all year, with no daylight saving changes.

## Specializations
1. AI and technology implementation: turning innovation, technology, and AI strategy into programs, systems, and automations that actually ship, for enterprises, governments, and universities.
2. Education and training: AI-powered learning built on strong visualization and interactivity, AI-fluency training, corporate training, curriculum and learning design, and national-scale education programs.

## Mantra
"Be the ordinary, build the extraordinary."

## Philosophy
Three directional preferences: slow rather than fast (with intention and focus), quality rather than quantity, calmness rather than noise.

Three operating principles:
1. Add value to others.
2. Focus on what truly matters.
3. Never forget your roots.

## Featured Work

### Bitcoin Diploma 2.0 (2025-present)
A complete redesign of El Salvador's flagship Bitcoin and modern finance curriculum, built with the National Bitcoin Office (ONBTC) under the direction of Stacy Herbert. Officially announced by Nelson at Bitcoin Histórico in November 2025. The Ministry of Education plans to bring it to up to 500,000 students over the coming years.
Coverage: Cointelegraph en Español, Bitcoineros (ARD/BR, ZDF), El Salvador in English, Diario El Salvador, news.bitcoin.com

### ADDN Technology & Innovation Advisor (2024-present)
Ad-honorem Technology and Innovation Advisor to the ADDN (Agency for National Development and Design), El Salvador's strategic planning body. Work centers on megatrends strategy for national planning, AI-fluency training for government teams, and design and implementation of AI systems to modernize government operations.

### Gloria Kriete Foundation (2020-present)
A multi-year partnership with one of Central America's most respected educational foundations. WeSpark has supported Programa Oportunidades through workshops, curriculum design, and trainer development. Formalized through a Memorandum of Understanding in 2022, renewed in 2025.

## Books
- Unstable Innovation (January 2025): Written for innovators navigating uncertainty and the gap between corporate frameworks and what works in the field. Read by more than 2,000 innovators since launch. Available at unstableinnovation.com ISBN 979-8-89686-562-9 (Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/Unstable-Innovation-Fragile-State-Understand/dp/B0DV45TLS9)
- Diplomado en Bitcoin: Curso Oficial (April 2026): El Salvador's official national Bitcoin curriculum, co-published with MINED and ONBTC. ISBN 979-8-90329-854-9.
- Thinking in Images (forthcoming 2027): A framework for translating complex ideas into visual communication, influenced by Feynman's method and seven years of visual-first pedagogy.

## Career Timeline
- 2026-present: Co-Founder & CTO, everybodyknowsyou (EKY), San Salvador. Websites that Google and AI can find, and AI search consulting, for companies in Central America; runs most of its operations with AI
- 2026: Bitcoin Diploma 2.0 finalized (National Bitcoin Office of El Salvador, co-designed with WeSpark)
- 2025: Co-founded WeSpark S.A.S. de C.V. in El Salvador (San Salvador, with Adam Nili)
- 2023-2024: Co-Founder, EarnB (Bitcoin-only marketing platform, Frankfurt)
- 2019-present: Co-Founder & CEO, WeSpark (Frankfurt to San Salvador)
- 2016-2019: Lufthansa Group, Frankfurt. Senior Innovation Manager (2017-2019) and ProTeam Member (2016-2017); built four new innovation departments and strategies across Lufthansa Group companies
- 2010-2016: Early roles and internships in El Salvador. Microsoft intern (2015), project leader at Aeroman (2015-2016), Business Intelligence consultant at Avianca (2013), and Siemens apprenticeship (2010)
- 2013-2015: MBA, Sales and Service Engineering, Furtwangen University, Germany
- 2012-2015: Marquardt Group, Germany. Business Intelligence Strategy Intern (2014-2015) and Sales Project Developer (2012-2013), with strategy work for Marquardt India as bachelor thesis
- 2009-2013: Bachelor of Engineering (B.Eng.), Industrial Engineering / Product Development Engineering, Furtwangen University, Germany
- 1991-2009: Born and raised in El Salvador. German School of San Salvador, International Baccalaureate Diploma
